title: Flag Fall (miniquest)
start: Speak with Boni at the Waiko market. (Quartermaster Gully, south-east of the Port Sarim pub, can sail you to Waiko in the Arc region of the Wushanko Isles.)

rewards.t: Ability to claim an uncharted isle
Claim island flag in Waiko reward shop

steps.t: Speak to Boni at the Waiko market. [Chat: 1 How do I claim an uncharted isle? › Accept]

sub.t: If you have just completed Impressing the Locals you may need to relog for the chat option to show up.

steps.t: Buy at least 5 supplies from Rosie in the marketplace, or take them from the crate next to her.
Talk to Quartermaster Gully to charter your ship on a voyage.

sub.t: A trip to a Short Junket costs 5 supplies per voyage.

steps.t: Collect all the driftwood (if any) from the island.
Repeat this process until 5 driftwood has been gathered.
Return to Boni. [Chat: 1 How do I claim an uncharted isle?]
